svg.title: How figma-cli connects to Figma, compared with API-based MCP servers
svg.desc: figma-cli: you talk to an AI assistant (Claude Code, Cursor or Codex), it runs figma-cli, which drives Figma Desktop directly on your machine over the Chrome DevTools Protocol or a plugin. No token, no rate limit, works offline. API-based MCP servers instead go from the assistant through an MCP server to the Figma REST API in the cloud, which needs a token and is rate limited.
